title: 7.9 Inch Hamster Ball, Running Ball Toy, Transparent, Breathable, Reduce Stress, Promote Exercise Health, Easy To Clean, Hamster Accessory, For Syrian  Hamster, Gerbils, Mice, Small Pets
body_html:
• 【Promotes Exercise & Health】The hamster ball provides hamsters with a space to run freely, helping to increase their physical activity, strengthen their constitution, and eliminate excess fat.
  • 【Relieves Stress】Hamsters can feel depressed and anxious when confined to their cages for long periods without enough exercise. This exercise ball offers an effective way for them to release stress.
  • 【Transparent Material】The main body of the ball is made of transparent plastic, allowing owners to observe their hamsters' activities inside the ball at any time, enhancing interactive fun.
  • 【Ventilation & Grip Design】The ball features elongated holes that serve as both breathing vents to ensure hamsters can breathe smoothly while running, and as grip holes to help hamsters maintain stability inside the ball, reducing the risk of falls and injuries.
  • 【Larger Range of Movement】The hamster ball provides hamsters with an activity space beyond the confines of their cage, allowing them to run and play to their heart's content. It promotes their physical and mental well-being by letting them enjoy the joy and satisfaction of freedom.
  • 【Easy to Clean】The detachable design make the ball easy to clean, maintaining hygiene and providing a clean exercise environment for hamsters.
